how_to_read: sentences[].w = first..last word id inside this chapter; word k (0-based) of the sentence is first+k and `ar` is the spoken text (its space-separated tokens are those words); fr = [start_frame, end_frame] at 24 fps from the word map; impact = hook words (id=text); num = spoken numbers with data-contract fact ids; first_mention = glossary terms to chip (id=term); dup = same claim in another chapter. Anchor with {word, lead_frames} only. Visual candidates are ideas, never footage.

constraints.anchors: {word, lead_frames} only; never seconds or frames; event frame = word start - lead_frames
constraints.lead_frames: kinetic word -3, graphic state change -2, shot cut -4..-6 (inside a pause >= 200 ms), counter starts at the number word
constraints.density: >= 20 events/min; no gap > 4 s without an event (hold <= 6 s with reason); shot median 6-12 s, max 25 s (shots > 12 s: an event every 3 s)
constraints.coverage: every sentence >= 1 anchored event; >= 80 % of sentences a mechanism event; every spoken number and every first-mention term on screen
constraints.kinetic: 8-20 kinetic words per minute; <= 6 words and <= 2 lines on screen; impact word 1-2 words
constraints.fx: hero (real-time 3D) <= 5 % of chapter frames (ADR-002 RT5); fx_tier lite|standard|hero
constraints.text: text on busy backgrounds needs a plate or halo; sizes and safe areas: 04 sections 3.2 and 3.4
banned: invented numbers (every number: data-contract id or source sentence)
constraints.components: use only frozen components (harness/schemas/components/); requests go to corpus/specs/_component_requests.jsonl
constraints.chapter_rhythm: problem -> mental model -> progressive visual -> worked example -> prediction -> failure (crit) -> fix (ok) -> callback -> artifact (per chapter, not per sentence)

storyboard_notes.text: CH-15..CH-20 zigzag and CH-17 before CH-23 (ADR-001): open and close with callbacks that re-establish where we are on the A-01 map and name the chapter we return to.

sentences.ar: الـsoftware craft هو الفرق بين كود شغال النهارده ونظام حد يقدر يغيّره السنة الجاية.
sentences.en: Software craft is the difference between code that works today and a system somebody can change next year.
Start with a measurement, not a slogan.

sentences.ar: أهو طلب تغيير واحد، وأهو الـcall graph بينوّر ست ملفات لازم تتلمس عشان الطلب ده يتحقق.
sentences.en: Here is one change request, and here is the call graph lighting up six files that have to be touched to satisfy it.
That is coupling, and you can see it.

sentences.ar: قسّم الـmodule على مسؤولياته الحقيقية، ونفس التغيير يلمس ملف واحد.
sentences.en: Split the module along its actual responsibilities and the same change touches one file.
That is cohesion, and you can see that too.

sentences.ar: والـSOLID مش خمس وصايا؛ دي خمس أوجاع متكررة اتسمّت بأسماء.
sentences.en: SOLID is not five commandments; it is five recurring pains with names attached.

sentences.ar: حطّ سياسة ورا interface وتقدر تبدّلها من غير ما تلمس اللي بينده دي dependency inversion وهي بتشتغل فعلاً، مش وهي بتتقال.
sentences.en: Put a policy behind an interface and you can swap it without editing the caller — that is dependency inversion earning its keep, not reciting itself.

sentences.ar: والـrefactoring معناه تغيير البنية من غير تغيير السلوك، وده ما بيبقاش آمن إلا لو في حاجة ماسكة السلوك ثابت.
sentences.en: Refactoring means changing structure without changing behaviour, which is only safe if something is holding the behaviour still.
That something is the test suite.

sentences.ar: بصّ: خطوة صغيّرة، الـtests خضرا؛ خطوة صغيّرة، خضرا؛ خطوة صغيّرة، test أحمر يبقى ارجع عن الخطوة دي وفكّر تاني.
sentences.en: Watch: small step, tests green; small step, tests green; small step, test red — so revert that one and think again.

sentences.ar: من غير tests، الـrefactoring مجرد إعادة كتابة ودعوة.
sentences.en: Without tests, refactoring is just rewriting and hoping.

sentences.ar: بعدها الـreview. الـreview الكويس بيقرا الـdiff مقابل معايير القبول، وبيسأل عن الصح والـedge cases والأمان والقارئ الجاي،
sentences.en: Then review. A good review reads the diff against the acceptance criteria and asks about correctness, edge cases, security and the next reader,

sentences.ar: والتعليق الكويس بيشرح الأثر مش بيقول أنا مش عاجبني.
sentences.en: and a good comment explains the impact rather than stating a preference.

sentences.ar: وكل قرار مهم بيسيب architecture decision record: اخترنا إيه، رفضنا إيه، وهيكلّفنا إيه.
sentences.en: And every significant decision leaves an architecture decision record: what we chose, what we rejected, and what it will cost us.

sentences.ar: والتصميم اللي ما فيهوش بديل مرفوض تصميم محدش أخده فعلاً.
sentences.en: A design with no discarded option is a design nobody actually made.

facts.rule: A number goes on screen with its fact id as `ref`/`data_refs`. `unmatched_numbers` are spoken but have no data-contract fact: their source is the sentence itself (a valid `s:` ref); never replace them with a different figure.

glossary.rule: Explain the term in Egyptian Arabic the first time it appears; then use the original term naturally, in Latin script, inside Arabic sentences.
glossary.register_ar: Natural Egyptian, clear, calm, professional. Use إحنا and خلّينا نشوف and ببساطة where they help. No heavy Modern Standard Arabic. No exaggerated slang. Numbers are spoken naturally in Egyptian but displayed as Western digits.
glossary.register_en: Plain, direct, unhurried. Short sentences. No hype, no "imagine that…", no rhetorical questions that are not real prediction prompts. Say the number, then pause for half a beat before the next sentence — the pause is where the viewer reads the screen.
glossary.never_translate_rule: Explain them in Egyptian Arabic the first time they appear, then use the original term naturally.
glossary.on_screen: Western digits, Latin terms in LTR isolates, Egyptian Arabic copy (no MSA), no per-letter animation (04 section 3.4).

concepts.def_en: A diagram of which functions or files call which others, revealing how many places a single change must touch.
concepts.def_ar: رسم بيوضّح مين بينده مين من الـfunctions أو الملفات، وبيبيّن تغيير واحد هيلمس كام مكان.
concepts.failure: Estimating change impact by guesswork instead of drawing the call graph first.

concepts.def_en: A set of nodes connected by edges, used to model relationships such as roads, dependencie…
concepts.failure: Confusing a graph (nodes and edges) with a chart (plotted data).

concepts.def_en: How strongly one part of the code depends on others; high coupling means a single change ripples through many files.
concepts.def_ar: قد إيه جزء من الكود معتمد على أجزاء تانية؛ لما الـcoupling يعلى، تغيير واحد بيمشي ويلمس ملفات كتير.
concepts.failure: Treating tight coupling as harmless until one change forces edits across many files.

concepts.def_en: How focused a module is on one responsibility; high cohesion means all its parts serve a single job.
concepts.def_ar: قد إيه الجزء الواحد مركّز على شغلانة واحدة؛ الـcohesion العالي معناه إن كل أجزائه بتخدم نفس الهدف.
concepts.failure: Stuffing unrelated responsibilities into one class, so every change touches the same file.

concepts.def_en: Five object-oriented design principles, each a named fix for a recurring maintenance pain rather than a slogan to memorize.
concepts.def_ar: خمس مبادئ تصميم object-oriented، كل واحد علاج مسمّى لوجع صيانة بيتكرر، مش شعار يتحفظ.
concepts.failure: Memorizing the five letters as slogans instead of diagnosing the pain each one fixes.

concepts.def_en: A contract listing the methods a component must provide while hiding how they work; callers depend on it, not on the implementation.
concepts.def_ar: عقد بيحدد الـmethods اللي لازم الـcomponent يقدّمها من غير ما يكشف بتشتغل إزاي؛ اللي بينده بيعتمد عليه مش على التنفيذ.
concepts.failure: Calling the concrete class directly, so swapping the implementation forces editing every caller.

concepts.def_en: High-level code depends on an interface (abstraction) instead of concrete details, so implementations can be swapped without editing the caller.
concepts.def_ar: الـdependency inversion إن الكود عالي المستوى يعتمد على interface مش على تفاصيل، فتبدّل الـimplementation من غير ما تلمس اللي بينده.
concepts.failure: Confusing it with dependency injection; one is the principle, the other a technique.

concepts.def_en: Restructuring existing code to improve its design without changing its behavior, made safe by tests that keep passing.
concepts.def_ar: إعادة ترتيب الكود الموجود لتحسين تصميمه من غير ما سلوكه يتغيّر، وبأمان بفضل tests بتفضل ناجحة.
concepts.failure: Refactoring without tests, so a behavior change slips in unnoticed.

concepts.def_en: An automated check that runs code and asserts the expected result, so changes that break…
concepts.failure: Tests that never fail prove nothing; first watch the test fail, then fix.

concepts.def_en: Testable conditions a change must satisfy to count as done; reviewers read the diff against them.
concepts.def_ar: شروط قابلة للاختبار لازم التغيير يحققها عشان نعتبره خلص؛ والـreview بيقرا الـdiff على أساسها.
concepts.failure: Vague criteria like 'works well' that nobody can test or verify.

components.does: One whole word (or a tatweel-joined compound like الـKafka) on screen; never split per letter.
Up to 6 kinetic words on at most 2 lines, each word arriving on its own spoken word anchor.
A technical term chip (Latin in an LTR isolate) with an optional Arabic gloss; 28 px floor if spoken.
A counter that rolls from the previous value to the target over the spoken number (preset count).
An arrow from a label to a target layer (or a named part of it, 'layer.part').
Failure beat: glitch + low thud; flashes stay <= 3/s (WCAG 2.3.1).
Fix beat: the target settles into place with a settle chime.
The shot camera: move + ease + intensity; drift always on; optional impact nudges (<= 4 px) on anchors.
Match cut between a layer of this shot and one of the next.
Lower-third caption for a source, term, speaker or location.
Draw an SVG path (stroke reveal; RTL by default for Arabic layouts).
Modules grouped in clusters with dependencies.
Tests that run and pass, fail or skip before a merge gate.
Commits on branches; checkout, commit and merge on anchors.
Trunk chapter title card (riser + sting in the SFX map).
